verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 documents a refreshable soft `ttl` that can keep a sandbox running while work continues, plus a separate `hard_ttl`. It also offers a session supervisor for background workers and agent runtimes that must outlive an SDK call, and pause/resume that preserves the full RootFS so long tasks can span pauses. Per-second compute billing with no one-hour minimum fits long sessions. Missing for 10: an explicit documented maximum runtime or a stated hours-to-days guarantee, non-experimental preservation of in-memory process state across pauses, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-day sessions.
